title: Austin Charts Course: Goals, Budget, City Manager Search
summary:
*   Officials convened a special meeting to discuss the process and timeline for setting future Council goals and priorities.
*   Key upcoming topics for August were outlined, including the 1988-89 Financial Plan (budget) and initiating a search for a new City Manager.
*   The Mayor emphasized the need for measurable goals with clear timelines for accountability.

Council Chambers, 307 West Second Street, Austin, Texas : Mayor Cooke called to order the
special called meeting of the Council, noting the absence of Councilmembers Humphrey and
Urdy.
WORKSESSION
Council held a worksession on discussion of Council Goals and Priorities.
a. Development of Process
b. Development of Timeline
Mayor Cooke discussed the timeline and said there should be a measureability of goals
concerning timelines.
He said Council will be discussing the 1988-89 Financial Plan, setting timelines and
conducting a City Manager search during the month of August.
Mayor Pro Tem Shipman said Council should share their budget goals at the first budget
worksession. ADJOURNMENT The meeting was adjourned at 3:40 p.m. Council did not hold a
worksession, nor did they make any board or commission appointments.
